title: Frame-scoped evaluate reads a cross-origin child the top document cannot touch
description: Inserts a cross-origin child and reads its script-computed message via a frame-scoped evaluate, the only legal route into a cross-origin frame.

steps.expression: var f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = 'http://localhost:' + location.port + '/v0_4/frames/child?tag=xo'; f.id = 'xo'; f.onload = function () { window.__xo_loaded = true; }; document.getElementById('slot').appendChild(f); 'inserted'
